title: The Protection Discount a Membership Carries on Travel Protection Plans Cover
content:
These questions are answered for the protection discount that applies to a Travel Protection Plans certificate when the destination loading owed on it is rated. The membership record read is the traveller's membership of the Wanderlane Traveller Club: whether that membership stands active, the day the tier held took effect, and the protection discount the tier held carries.

**Where the traveller's club membership stands active and the tier held took effect on or before the day the certificate was issued, what is the protection discount that applies?**

It is the protection discount that tier carries, as the Wanderlane Traveller Club records that discount for the tier the traveller holds.

**Where the membership stands active and the tier held took effect after the day the certificate was issued, what is the protection discount that applies?**

The standing protection discount of the house applies instead, which is 5 per cent.

**Where neither of those holds, what is the protection discount that applies?**

The certificate carries no protection discount at all: 0 per cent.

## The three cases side by side

| Standing of the membership | Day the tier held took effect | Protection discount that applies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Active | On or before the day the certificate was issued | The protection discount that tier carries |
| Active | After the day the certificate was issued | 5 per cent |
| Anything else | Not reached | 0 per cent |

**On which day is the comparison made?**

On the day the certificate was issued. A tier whose effective day is the issue day itself falls in the first case, because that case takes the effective day on or before the issue day; a tier whose effective day is the day after the issue day falls in the second, at 5 per cent.

**Where the membership does not stand active, does the day the tier took effect matter?**

No. Both of the first two cases require an active membership. Where the membership is not active, the third case is reached whatever the dates show, and the discount is 0 per cent.
